title: CIMAF Gabon commissions new 1.8Mt/yr line at Owendo cement plant
summary: CIMAF Gabon commissions new 1.8Mt/yr line at Owendo cement plant
body_markdown:
**Gabon:** CIMAF Gabon commissioned a new, third production line at its Owendo cement plant in Estuaire on 26 November 2026. African Press Organization News has reported that the line has a capacity of around 1.8Mt/yr and will raise the Owendo plant’s capacity from just 85,000t/yr to around 1.9Mt/yr.


The government reportedly expects the plant to help serve growing domestic cement demand.
